issues.where: far field and horizon, full width at about y 370-400
issues.what: the far field ends in a flat, even pink-brown band with a straight top edge and a hard line where field detail stops; with the hill silhouette above it, the background reads as a flat painted backdrop, not land going away into haze
issues.fix: let plant rows carry on into the distance and thin out into depth-based haze that rises gradually; break up the band's straight edges and give it variation in tone

issues.where: crop 4, left of the stem under the leaf (also seen in set-C-03.png at about x 850, y 650-788)
issues.what: a bright vertical white streak sits behind the stem with nothing in the scene to cause it; it looks like a light leak or a lit card edge
issues.fix: find and remove the stray lit geometry or rim-light bleed behind the stem, or occlude it

issues.where: crops 1-2, the bud's bracts and the inner straps
issues.what: the bracts are near copies of each other in shape, size and spacing, and every edge has the same thin white outline of the same width; the inner strap leaves are flat, evenly dark cards with no translucency against the sky
issues.fix: vary each bract's length, width, curl and twist; make the backlit hair fringe vary in density and brightness; add light through the thin strap tips

issues.what: the hairs on the bracts are an even bright fringe that follows every edge exactly, like an outline effect; the bracts repeat in shape and fan out with regular spacing
issues.fix: put hair density and length on a random map, let some hairs stray off the edge, and change each bract's shape and angle

issues.what: the florets are one repeated bump on a perfect phyllotaxis grid with matching size, shading and specular dots, and no florets at different stages from the rim to the centre; it reads as procedural instancing
issues.fix: vary floret scale, tilt and colour, add open florets with pollen near the rim, and break up the regularity

issues.where: long green bracts lying across the front of the disc, centre of the head
issues.what: narrow green straps pass in front of the disc and look pasted over it, with no contact shadow where they meet the florets; they read as geometry cutting through
issues.fix: pull these bracts back behind the ray ring, or give them proper contact and occlusion where they touch the disc

issues.what: the sun is a flat, evenly filled disc with a hard rim and almost no scatter, even though it sits inside thick cloud; it looks laid on top of the sky
issues.fix: soften the edge, add glow and scatter that match the density of the cloud, and let the cloud partly cover the disc

issues.what: the ray veins are faint, regular painted lines, and the petal edges are very clean, with little crinkle or tearing
issues.fix: add slight waviness, small tears and uneven vein relief to the rays

issues.what: the yellowed serrated edges are evenly spaced and the leaf is a thin sheet with no visible edge thickness or curl
issues.fix: break up the serration rhythm and add a little edge curl and thickness
